# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

# Pyomo Nonlinear Optimization Skill

## Overview
Pyomo is a Python-based open-source optimization modeling language. It supports linear, mixed-integer, and nonlinear programming with various solvers.

## Installation
```bash
pip install pyomo numpy scipy
# For IPOPT solver (nonlinear):
pip install idaes-pse
idaes get-extensions  # Downloads IPOPT binary
```

## Key Concepts

### Model Construction
```python
import pyomo.environ as pyo

model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

# Sets
model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=[1, 2, 3])

# Parameters
model.cost = pyo.Param(model.N, initialize={1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 15})

# Variables
model.x = pyo.Var(model.N, within=pyo.Reals, bounds=(0, 100))

# Objective
model.obj = pyo.Objective(
    expr=sum(model.cost[i] * model.x[i] for i in model.N),
    sense=pyo.minimize
)

# Constraints
model.balance = pyo.Constraint(
    expr=sum(model.x[i] for i in model.N) == 50
)
```

### Nonlinear (Trigonometric) Expressions
```python
from pyomo.environ import sin, cos, sqrt, atan2

# For AC power flow, use rectangular coordinates:
model.vr = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=1.0)  # real part of voltage
model.vi = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=0.0)  # imaginary part

# Voltage magnitude constraint (nonlinear):
def vm_lower(model, i):
    return model.vr[i]**2 + model.vi[i]**2 >= model.vmin[i]**2
model.vm_lb = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=vm_lower)
```

### Solving with IPOPT
```python
solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt', executable='/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt')
solver.options['max_iter'] = 10000
solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'

results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)

# Check status
if results.solver.termination_condition == pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
    print("Optimal solution found")
    print("Objective:", pyo.value(model.obj))
```

### Tips for Large Models
- Use `pyo.ConcreteModel()` for data-driven models
- Initialize variables with good starting points (e.g., flat start for power flow)
- Use rectangular voltage coordinates to avoid trigonometric nonlinearities
- Set appropriate bounds on all variables

# AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Formulation Skill

## Overview
AC-OPF finds the minimum-cost generator dispatch that satisfies AC power flow equations, voltage limits, line flow limits, and generator limits.

## Data Format (MATPOWER-style)

### Bus Data Columns
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | BUS_I | Bus number |
| 1 | BUS_TYPE | 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack |
| 2 | PD | Real power demand (MW) |
| 3 | QD | Reactive power demand (MVAr) |
| 4 | GS | Shunt conductance (MW demanded at V=1.0 p.u.) |
| 5 | BS | Shunt susceptance (MVAr injected at V=1.0 p.u.) |
| 6 | BUS_AREA | Area number |
| 7 | VM | Voltage magnitude (p.u.) |
| 8 | VA | Voltage angle (degrees) |
| 9 | BASE_KV | Base voltage (kV) |
| 10 | ZONE | Loss zone |
| 11 | VMAX | Maximum voltage (p.u.) |
| 12 | VMIN | Minimum voltage (p.u.) |

### Generator Data Columns
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | GEN_BUS | Bus number |
| 1 | PG | Real power output (MW) |
| 2 | QG | Reactive power output (MVAr) |
| 3 | QMAX | Maximum reactive power (MVAr) |
| 4 | QMIN | Minimum reactive power (MVAr) |
| 5 | VG | Voltage magnitude setpoint (p.u.) |
| 6 | MBASE | Total MVA base |
| 7 | GEN_STATUS | 1=in-service, 0=out-of-service |
| 8 | PMAX | Maximum real power (MW) |
| 9 | PMIN | Minimum real power (MW) |

### Branch Data Columns
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | F_BUS | From bus number |
| 1 | T_BUS | To bus number |
| 2 | BR_R | Resistance (p.u.) |
| 3 | BR_X | Reactance (p.u.) |
| 4 | BR_B | Total line charging susceptance (p.u.) |
| 5 | RATE_A | Long term rating (MVA), 0 = unlimited |
| 6 | RATE_B | Short term rating (MVA) |
| 7 | RATE_C | Emergency rating (MVA) |
| 8 | TAP | Transformer off-nominal tap ratio, 0 or 1 = nominal |
| 9 | SHIFT | Transformer phase shift (degrees) |
| 10 | BR_STATUS | 1=in-service |
| 11 | ANGMIN | Min angle difference (degrees) |
| 12 | ANGMAX | Max angle difference (degrees) |

### Generator Cost Data
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | MODEL | 1=piecewise linear, 2=polynomial |
| 1 | STARTUP | Startup cost |
| 2 | SHUTDOWN | Shutdown cost |
| 3 | NCOST | Number of coefficients |
| 4+ | COST | Coefficients (highest order first) |

For polynomial model 2 with NCOST=3: cost = c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0

## Rectangular Formulation

Using rectangular voltage coordinates (Vr + j*Vi) avoids trigonometric functions:

### Branch Pi-Model
For a branch from bus i to bus j with:
- Series admittance: y_s = 1/(r + jx)
- Shunt charging: b_c (total)
- Tap ratio: tau (real, or tau*e^{j*shift})

The pi-model parameters:
- Y_ij = y_s (series admittance)
- Y^c_ij = j * b_c / 2 (from-side charging, for lines)
- Y^c_ji = j * b_c / 2 (to-side charging, for lines)
- T_ij = tap * e^{j*shift_rad} (complex tap ratio)

If tap == 0, treat as tap = 1 (no transformation).

### Power Flow Equations (from math-model.md)
```
S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * Vi * conj(Vj) / T_ij
S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2               -  conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi) * Vj / conj(T_ij)
```

In rectangular coordinates with V_i = (e_i + j*f_i):
- |V_i|^2 = e_i^2 + f_i^2
- V_i * conj(V_j) = (e_i*e_j + f_i*f_j) + j*(f_i*e_j - e_i*f_j)

### Nodal Balance
```
sum(Sg_k for k in G_i) - sum(Sd_k for k in L_i) - conj(Ys_i)*|Vi|^2 = sum(S_ij for branches at i)
```

1. All impedances in the data are in per-unit on system baseMVA
2. Power values in the data are in MW/MVAr; divide by baseMVA for per-unit
3. Shunt GS/BS at buses are in MW/MVAr at V=1.0 p.u.; divide by baseMVA
4. Branch limits (RATE_A) are in MVA; divide by baseMVA for per-unit
5. RATE_A = 0 means unconstrained
6. Generator cost coefficients: for MODEL=2, c2 is $/MW^2/hr, c1 is $/MW/hr, c0 is $/hr
   - Cost = c2 * (Pg_MW)^2 + c1 * Pg_MW + c0

```python
gen_data = np.array(data['gen'])
branch_data = np.array(data['branch'])
gencost_data = np.array(data['gencost'])

active_gens = gen_data[gen_data[:, 7] == 1]  # GEN_STATUS == 1
active_branches = branch_data[branch_data[:, 10] == 1]  # BR_STATUS == 1

# Create bus index mapping (bus numbers may not be contiguous)
bus_ids = bus_data[:, 0].astype(int)
bus_idx = {int(b): i for i, b in enumerate(bus_ids)}
```

```python
def build_branch_data(branch, baseMVA):
    """Build branch admittance parameters for pi-model."""
    f_bus = int(branch[0])
    t_bus = int(branch[1])
    r = branch[2]
    x = branch[3]
    b_ch = branch[4]
    rate_a = branch[5]
    tap = branch[8]
    shift = branch[9]

    if tap == 0:
        tap = 1.0

    # Series admittance
    y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x) if (r != 0 or x != 0) else complex(0, -1/x)

    # Shunt charging (split equally)
    y_ch_from = complex(0, b_ch / 2.0)
    y_ch_to = complex(0, b_ch / 2.0)

    # Complex tap ratio
    shift_rad = np.radians(shift)
    T = tap * complex(np.cos(shift_rad), np.sin(shift_rad))

    return f_bus, t_bus, y_s, y_ch_from, y_ch_to, T, rate_a
```

- Handle tap=0 as tap=1 (nominal ratio)
- Bus shunt GS+jBS: GS is conductance (MW at 1 p.u.), BS is susceptance (MVAr at 1 p.u.)

## Overview
IPOPT (Interior Point OPTimizer) is a software package for large-scale nonlinear optimization. It is the standard solver for AC-OPF problems.

```bash
idaes get-extensions
```

```python
import pyomo.environ as pyo

solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt', executable='/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt')

# Recommended options for AC-OPF
solver.options['max_iter'] = 50000
solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
solver.options['print_level'] = 5
solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'  # or 'ma27' if available
```

Parse MATPOWER-style network data stored in JSON format and convert to Python data structures for OPF computation.

```python
    data = json.load(f)

bus_data = np.array(data['bus'])
gen_data = np.array(data['gen'])
branch_data = np.array(data['branch'])
gencost_data = np.array(data['gencost'])

# Filter in-service components

# Create bus index mapping (bus numbers may not be contiguous)
bus_ids = bus_data[:, 0].astype(int)
bus_idx = {int(b): i for i, b in enumerate(bus_ids)}
```

## Building Admittance Data
```python
def build_branch_data(branch, baseMVA):
    """Build branch admittance parameters for pi-model."""
    f_bus = int(branch[0])
    t_bus = int(branch[1])
    r = branch[2]
    x = branch[3]
    b_ch = branch[4]
    rate_a = branch[5]
    tap = branch[8]
    shift = branch[9]

    if tap == 0:
        tap = 1.0

    # Series admittance
    y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x) if (r != 0 or x != 0) else complex(0, -1/x)

    # Shunt charging (split equally)
    y_ch_from = complex(0, b_ch / 2.0)
    y_ch_to = complex(0, b_ch / 2.0)

    # Complex tap ratio
    shift_rad = np.radians(shift)
    T = tap * complex(np.cos(shift_rad), np.sin(shift_rad))

    return f_bus, t_bus, y_s, y_ch_from, y_ch_to, T, rate_a
```

## Tips
- Always check for zero-impedance branches (transformers may have r=0, x>0)
- Handle tap=0 as tap=1 (nominal ratio)
- Bus shunt GS+jBS: GS is conductance (MW at 1 p.u.), BS is susceptance (MVAr at 1 p.u.)
- Convert to per-unit by dividing by baseMVA

## Overview
IPOPT (Interior Point OPTimizer) is a software package for large-scale nonlinear optimization. It is the standard solver for AC-OPF problems.

```python
import pyomo.environ as pyo

solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt', executable='/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt')

# Recommended options for AC-OPF
solver.options['max_iter'] = 50000
solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
solver.options['print_level'] = 5
solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'  # or 'ma27' if available
```

"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Uses Pyomo with IPOPT to solve the full AC-OPF problem
in rectangular voltage coordinates, following the math-model.md formulation.
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Load network data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data["baseMVA"]
bus_raw = np.array(data["bus"])
gen_raw = np.array(data["gen"])
branch_raw = np.array(data["branch"])
gencost_raw = np.array(data["gencost"])

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Pre-process data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
bus_ids = bus_raw[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
n_bus = len(bus_ids)
bus_id2idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

# Bus parameters
pd = bus_raw[:, 2] / baseMVA       # per-unit
qd = bus_raw[:, 3] / baseMVA
gs = bus_raw[:, 4] / baseMVA       # shunt conductance (pu)
bs = bus_raw[:, 5] / baseMVA       # shunt susceptance (pu)
vmin = bus_raw[:, 12]
vmax = bus_raw[:, 11]
bus_type = bus_raw[:, 1].astype(int)

# Reference bus
ref_buses = [bus_ids[i] for i in range(n_bus) if bus_type[i] == 3]

# Generator parameters  (only in-service)
gen_mask = gen_raw[:, 7] == 1
gen_active = gen_raw[gen_mask]
gencost_active = gencost_raw[gen_mask]
n_gen = len(gen_active)

gen_bus = gen_active[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
pg_init = gen_active[:, 1] / baseMVA
qg_init = gen_active[:, 2] / baseMVA
qmax = gen_active[:, 3] / baseMVA
qmin = gen_active[:, 4] / baseMVA
pmax = gen_active[:, 8] / baseMVA
pmin = gen_active[:, 9] / baseMVA

# Generator cost:  cost = c2*(Pg_MW)^2 + c1*Pg_MW + c0
# We keep costs in original MW basis (objective in $/hr)
cost_c2 = gencost_active[:, 4]
cost_c1 = gencost_active[:, 5]
cost_c0 = gencost_active[:, 6]

# Map generators to buses
gens_at_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}
for g in range(n_gen):
    gens_at_bus[gen_bus[g]].append(g)

# Branch parameters  (only in-service)
br_mask = branch_raw[:, 10] == 1
br_active = branch_raw[br_mask]
n_branch = len(br_active)

br_f = br_active[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
br_t = br_active[:, 1].astype(int).tolist()
br_r = br_active[:, 2]
br_x = br_active[:, 3]
br_b = br_active[:, 4]
rate_a = br_active[:, 5] / baseMVA   # MVA -> pu
br_tap = br_active[:, 8].copy()
br_shift = br_active[:, 9]           # degrees
br_angmin = br_active[:, 11]
br_angmax = br_active[:, 12]

# Normalise tap
br_tap[br_tap == 0] = 1.0

# Compute branch admittance parameters
y_series = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
yc_from = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
yc_to = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
tap_complex = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)

for l in range(n_branch):
    z = complex(br_r[l], br_x[l])
    if abs(z) > 0:
        y_series[l] = 1.0 / z
    else:
        # Pure reactance shouldn't happen, but guard
        y_series[l] = complex(0, -1.0 / br_x[l]) if br_x[l] != 0 else 0
    yc_from[l] = complex(0, br_b[l] / 2.0)
    yc_to[l] = complex(0, br_b[l] / 2.0)
    shift_rad = math.radians(br_shift[l])
    tap_complex[l] = br_tap[l] * complex(math.cos(shift_rad), math.sin(shift_rad))

# Pre-compute real/imag parts for the Pyomo model
# For S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  - conj(Y_ij) * Vi * Vj* / T_ij
# Let A_l = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ij) / |T_ij|^2
# Let B_l = conj(Y_ij) / T_ij
# Then S_ij = A_l * |Vi|^2 - B_l * Vi * Vj*
#
# For S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ji) * |Vj|^2 - conj(Y_ij) * Vi* * Vj / T_ij*
# Let C_l = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ji)
# Let D_l = conj(Y_ij) / conj(T_ij)  = conj(Y_ij / T_ij) ... but actually conj(Y_ij) / conj(T_ij)
# Then S_ji = C_l * |Vj|^2 - D_l * Vi* * Vj

A_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
B_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
C_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
D_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)

for l in range(n_branch):
    t = tap_complex[l]
    t_mag2 = abs(t) ** 2
    ys = y_series[l]
    ycf = yc_from[l]
    yct = yc_to[l]

    A_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys + ycf) / t_mag2
    B_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys) / t
    C_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys + yct)
    D_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys) / np.conj(t)

# Extract real/imag
A_re = A_coeff.real;  A_im = A_coeff.imag
B_re = B_coeff.real;  B_im = B_coeff.imag
C_re = C_coeff.real;  C_im = C_coeff.imag
D_re = D_coeff.real;  D_im = D_coeff.imag

# Branches at each bus (for nodal balance)
branches_from_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}   # (l, 'from')
branches_to_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}     # (l, 'to')
for l in range(n_branch):
    branches_from_bus[br_f[l]].append(l)
    branches_to_bus[br_t[l]].append(l)

print(f"Network: {n_bus} buses, {n_gen} generators, {n_branch} branches")
print(f"Total load: {bus_raw[:,2].sum():.2f} MW, {bus_raw[:,3].sum():.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Reference bus: {ref_buses}")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Build Pyomo model
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
m = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# Sets
m.BUS = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
m.GEN = pyo.RangeSet(0, n_gen - 1)
m.BRANCH = pyo.RangeSet(0, n_branch - 1)

# Variables – rectangular voltage
m.e = pyo.Var(m.BUS, initialize=1.0)   # real part
m.f = pyo.Var(m.BUS, initialize=0.0)   # imaginary part

# Set voltage magnitude bounds via e, f bounds
# |V| in [vmin, vmax] => e^2+f^2 in [vmin^2, vmax^2]
# We set e in [-vmax, vmax], f in [-vmax, vmax] (loose box)
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    m.e[bid].setlb(-float(vmax[i]))
    m.e[bid].setub(float(vmax[i]))
    m.f[bid].setlb(-float(vmax[i]))
    m.f[bid].setub(float(vmax[i]))

# Generator power
m.pg = pyo.Var(m.GEN, initialize=0.5)
m.qg = pyo.Var(m.GEN, initialize=0.0)

for g in range(n_gen):
    m.pg[g].setlb(float(pmin[g]))
    m.pg[g].setub(float(pmax[g]))
    m.qg[g].setlb(float(qmin[g]))
    m.qg[g].setub(float(qmax[g]))
    # Init at midpoint
    m.pg[g].value = float((pmin[g] + pmax[g]) / 2.0)
    m.qg[g].value = float((qmin[g] + qmax[g]) / 2.0)

# Objective: minimize generation cost (in $/hr, using MW values)
# cost_k = c2_k * (pg_k * baseMVA)^2 + c1_k * (pg_k * baseMVA) + c0_k
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(
        float(cost_c2[g]) * (m.pg[g] * baseMVA) ** 2
        + float(cost_c1[g]) * (m.pg[g] * baseMVA)
        + float(cost_c0[g])
        for g in range(n_gen)
    )

m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

# Constraint: reference bus angle = 0  => f[ref] = 0
def ref_angle_rule(m, r):
    return m.f[r] == 0.0

m.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# Constraint: voltage magnitude bounds
# vmin^2 <= e^2 + f^2 <= vmax^2
def vm_lb_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    return m.e[bid] ** 2 + m.f[bid] ** 2 >= float(vmin[i]) ** 2

def vm_ub_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    return m.e[bid] ** 2 + m.f[bid] ** 2 <= float(vmax[i]) ** 2

m.vm_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=vm_lb_rule)
m.vm_ub = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=vm_ub_rule)

# Branch power flow expressions
# S_ij (from side):
#   P_ij = A_re * (ei^2+fi^2) - B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#   Q_ij = A_im * (ei^2+fi^2) + B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#     (note: for conj(...) * Vi * Vj*, we expand carefully)
#
# Actually: S_ij = A * |Vi|^2 - B * (Vi * Vj*)
#   where Vi*Vj* = (ei+jfi)(ej-jfj) = (ei*ej+fi*fj) + j(fi*ej - ei*fj)
# So P_ij = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)]
#         = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#    Q_ij = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)]
#         = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#
# Wait, let me redo this more carefully.
# S_ij = A * |Vi|^2 - B * Vi * conj(Vj)
# Let's denote Vi*conj(Vj) = W_ij
# W_ij = (ei + j*fi)*(ej - j*fj) = (ei*ej + fi*fj) + j*(fi*ej - ei*fj)
# So:
#   P_ij = Re(S_ij) = Re(A)*|Vi|^2 - Re(B * W_ij)
#        = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#   Q_ij = Im(S_ij) = Im(A)*|Vi|^2 - Im(B * W_ij)
#        = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_re*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#
# Similarly S_ji = C * |Vj|^2 - D * conj(Vi) * Vj
# conj(Vi)*Vj = (ei - j*fi)*(ej + j*fj) = (ei*ej+fi*fj) - j*(fi*ej - ei*fj) = conj(W_ij)
# So:
#   P_ji = C_re*(ej^2+fj^2) - [D_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + D_im*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#   Q_ji = C_im*(ej^2+fj^2) - [D_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - D_re*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#
# Wait: D * conj(W_ij) = (D_re + j*D_im) * ((ei*ej+fi*fj) - j*(fi*ej-ei*fj))
#   Re = D_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + D_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#   Im = D_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - D_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)

def pf_from(l, m):
    """Real power flow on from-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_i = ei**2 + fi**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(A_re[l]) * vm2_i - (float(B_re[l]) * re_wij - float(B_im[l]) * im_wij)

def qf_from(l, m):
    """Reactive power flow on from-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_i = ei**2 + fi**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(A_im[l]) * vm2_i - (float(B_im[l]) * re_wij + float(B_re[l]) * im_wij)

def pf_to(l, m):
    """Real power flow on to-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_j = ej**2 + fj**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(C_re[l]) * vm2_j - (float(D_re[l]) * re_wij + float(D_im[l]) * im_wij)

def qf_to(l, m):
    """Reactive power flow on to-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_j = ej**2 + fj**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(C_im[l]) * vm2_j - (float(D_im[l]) * re_wij - float(D_re[l]) * im_wij)

# Nodal power balance constraints
# sum(Pg) - Pd - Gs*|V|^2 = sum(Pf_from) + sum(Pf_to)   [real]
# sum(Qg) - Qd + Bs*|V|^2 = sum(Qf_from) + sum(Qf_to)   [reactive]
# Note: shunt admittance Y^s = gs + j*bs
#   conj(Y^s)*|V|^2 = (gs - j*bs)*|V|^2
#   Real part consumed: gs*|V|^2
#   Reactive part consumed: -bs*|V|^2  (i.e., bs > 0 injects reactive)

def p_balance_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    # Generation
    pg_sum = sum(m.pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    # Load
    load_p = float(pd[i])
    # Shunt: consumes gs*|V|^2
    shunt_p = float(gs[i]) * (m.e[bid]**2 + m.f[bid]**2)
    # Branch flows
    flow_p = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        flow_p += pf_from(l, m)
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        flow_p += pf_to(l, m)
    return pg_sum - load_p - shunt_p == flow_p

def q_balance_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    # Generation
    qg_sum = sum(m.qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    # Load
    load_q = float(qd[i])
    # Shunt: consumes -bs*|V|^2 reactive (bs > 0 => injects vars)
    shunt_q = -float(bs[i]) * (m.e[bid]**2 + m.f[bid]**2)
    # Branch flows
    flow_q = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        flow_q += qf_from(l, m)
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        flow_q += qf_to(l, m)
    return qg_sum - load_q - shunt_q == flow_q

m.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=p_balance_rule)
m.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=q_balance_rule)

# Branch flow limits: |S_ij|^2 <= (rate_a)^2   (from and to sides)
# Only for branches with finite limits
def sf_from_limit_rule(m, l):
    if rate_a[l] <= 0 or rate_a[l] > 99.0:  # 9900 MVA / 100 = 99 pu, effectively unlimited
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    p = pf_from(l, m)
    q = qf_from(l, m)
    return p**2 + q**2 <= float(rate_a[l])**2

def sf_to_limit_rule(m, l):
    if rate_a[l] <= 0 or rate_a[l] > 99.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    p = pf_to(l, m)
    q = qf_to(l, m)
    return p**2 + q**2 <= float(rate_a[l])**2

m.sf_from_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=sf_from_limit_rule)
m.sf_to_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=sf_to_limit_rule)

# Angle difference constraints
# theta_ij_min <= angle(Vi * conj(Vj)) <= theta_ij_max
# angle(Vi*conj(Vj)) = atan2(fi*ej - ei*fj, ei*ej + fi*fj)
# We linearize using: tan(min) * (ei*ej+fi*fj) <= (fi*ej-ei*fj) <= tan(max) * (ei*ej+fi*fj)
# This is valid when |theta| < 90 degrees, which is typical
def angle_diff_lb_rule(m, l):
    angmin = float(br_angmin[l])
    if angmin <= -90.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi_v = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    re_w = ei*ej + fi_v*fj
    im_w = fi_v*ej - ei*fj
    return im_w >= math.tan(math.radians(angmin)) * re_w

def angle_diff_ub_rule(m, l):
    angmax = float(br_angmax[l])
    if angmax >= 90.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi_v = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    re_w = ei*ej + fi_v*fj
    im_w = fi_v*ej - ei*fj
    return im_w <= math.tan(math.radians(angmax)) * re_w

m.angle_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angle_diff_lb_rule)
m.angle_ub = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angle_diff_ub_rule)

print("Model built. Solving...")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Solve
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
solver = pyo.SolverFactory("ipopt", executable="/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 50000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-4
solver.options["print_level"] = 5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-1

results = solver.solve(m, tee=True)

tc = results.solver.termination_condition
print(f"\nSolver termination: {tc}")

if tc not in (
    pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal,
    pyo.TerminationCondition.locallyOptimal,
    pyo.TerminationCondition.feasible,
):
    solver_status = str(tc)
    print(f"WARNING: Solver did not find optimal solution: {tc}")
else:
    solver_status = "optimal"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Extract results and build report
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
obj_val = pyo.value(m.obj)

# Generator results
gen_results = []
total_pg_mw = 0.0
total_qg_mvar = 0.0
for g in range(n_gen):
    pg_mw = pyo.value(m.pg[g]) * baseMVA
    qg_mvar = pyo.value(m.qg[g]) * baseMVA
    total_pg_mw += pg_mw
    total_qg_mvar += qg_mvar
    gen_results.append({
        "id": g + 1,
        "bus": gen_bus[g],
        "pg_MW": round(pg_mw, 2),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg_mvar, 2),
        "pmin_MW": round(float(pmin[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "pmax_MW": round(float(pmax[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(float(qmin[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(float(qmax[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
    })

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm = math.sqrt(e_val**2 + f_val**2)
    va = math.degrees(math.atan2(f_val, e_val))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": bid,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 4),
        "va_deg": round(va, 4),
        "vmin_pu": float(vmin[i]),
        "vmax_pu": float(vmax[i]),
    })

# Branch loading
branch_loadings = []
for l in range(n_branch):
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    # Compute flows
    pf_f = pyo.value(pf_from(l, m)) * baseMVA
    qf_f = pyo.value(qf_from(l, m)) * baseMVA
    pf_t = pyo.value(pf_to(l, m)) * baseMVA
    qf_t = pyo.value(qf_to(l, m)) * baseMVA
    mva_from = math.sqrt(pf_f**2 + qf_f**2)
    mva_to = math.sqrt(pf_t**2 + qf_t**2)
    limit_mva = float(rate_a[l]) * baseMVA
    if limit_mva > 0:
        loading = max(mva_from, mva_to) / limit_mva * 100.0
    else:
        loading = 0.0
    branch_loadings.append({
        "from_bus": fi_bus,
        "to_bus": ti_bus,
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 1),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(mva_from, 1),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(mva_to, 1),
        "limit_MVA": round(limit_mva, 1),
    })

# Sort by loading and take top 10
branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
top_branches = branch_loadings[:10]

# Feasibility check
total_load_mw = float(bus_raw[:, 2].sum())
total_load_mvar = float(bus_raw[:, 3].sum())
total_losses_mw = total_pg_mw - total_load_mw

# Compute power mismatches at each bus
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    # LHS of balance
    pg_sum = sum(pyo.value(m.pg[g]) for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm2 = e_val**2 + f_val**2

    lhs_p = pg_sum - float(pd[i]) - float(gs[i]) * vm2
    lhs_q = (sum(pyo.value(m.qg[g]) for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0) \
             - float(qd[i]) + float(bs[i]) * vm2

    # RHS: branch flows
    rhs_p = 0.0
    rhs_q = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        rhs_p += pyo.value(pf_from(l, m))
        rhs_q += pyo.value(qf_from(l, m))
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        rhs_p += pyo.value(pf_to(l, m))
        rhs_q += pyo.value(qf_to(l, m))

    p_mis = abs(lhs_p - rhs_p) * baseMVA
    q_mis = abs(lhs_q - rhs_q) * baseMVA
    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mis)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mis)

# Voltage violations
max_v_violation = 0.0
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm = math.sqrt(e_val**2 + f_val**2)
    v_viol = max(0, float(vmin[i]) - vm, vm - float(vmax[i]))
    max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, v_viol)

# Branch overloads
max_overload = 0.0
for bl in branch_loadings:
    if bl["limit_MVA"] > 0:
        overload = max(bl["flow_from_MVA"], bl["flow_to_MVA"]) - bl["limit_MVA"]
        if overload > 0:
            max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

# Build report
report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(obj_val, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_load_mw, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_load_mvar, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg_mw, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg_mvar, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses_mw, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": top_branches,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 2),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"ACOPF Solution Summary")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total Cost:       ${obj_val:,.2f}/hr")
print(f"Total Gen (P):    {total_pg_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Total Gen (Q):    {total_qg_mvar:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Load (P):   {total_load_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Total Load (Q):   {total_load_mvar:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Losses:     {total_losses_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Max P mismatch:   {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max Q mismatch:   {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max V violation:  {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
print(f"Max branch overload: {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
print(f"Solver status:    {solver_status}")
print(f"\nReport written to /root/report.json")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Uses Pyomo with IPOPT to solve the full AC-OPF problem
in rectangular voltage coordinates, following the math-model.md formulation.
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Load network data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data["baseMVA"]
bus_raw = np.array(data["bus"])
gen_raw = np.array(data["gen"])
branch_raw = np.array(data["branch"])
gencost_raw = np.array(data["gencost"])

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Pre-process data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
bus_ids = bus_raw[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
n_bus = len(bus_ids)
bus_id2idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

# Bus parameters
pd = bus_raw[:, 2] / baseMVA       # per-unit
qd = bus_raw[:, 3] / baseMVA
gs = bus_raw[:, 4] / baseMVA       # shunt conductance (pu)
bs = bus_raw[:, 5] / baseMVA       # shunt susceptance (pu)
vmin = bus_raw[:, 12]
vmax = bus_raw[:, 11]
bus_type = bus_raw[:, 1].astype(int)

# Reference bus
ref_buses = [bus_ids[i] for i in range(n_bus) if bus_type[i] == 3]

# Generator parameters  (only in-service)
gen_mask = gen_raw[:, 7] == 1
gen_active = gen_raw[gen_mask]
gencost_active = gencost_raw[gen_mask]
n_gen = len(gen_active)

gen_bus = gen_active[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
pg_init = gen_active[:, 1] / baseMVA
qg_init = gen_active[:, 2] / baseMVA
qmax = gen_active[:, 3] / baseMVA
qmin = gen_active[:, 4] / baseMVA
pmax = gen_active[:, 8] / baseMVA
pmin = gen_active[:, 9] / baseMVA

# Generator cost:  cost = c2*(Pg_MW)^2 + c1*Pg_MW + c0
# We keep costs in original MW basis (objective in $/hr)
cost_c2 = gencost_active[:, 4]
cost_c1 = gencost_active[:, 5]
cost_c0 = gencost_active[:, 6]

# Map generators to buses
gens_at_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}
for g in range(n_gen):
    gens_at_bus[gen_bus[g]].append(g)

# Branch parameters  (only in-service)
br_mask = branch_raw[:, 10] == 1
br_active = branch_raw[br_mask]
n_branch = len(br_active)

br_f = br_active[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()
br_t = br_active[:, 1].astype(int).tolist()
br_r = br_active[:, 2]
br_x = br_active[:, 3]
br_b = br_active[:, 4]
rate_a = br_active[:, 5] / baseMVA   # MVA -> pu
br_tap = br_active[:, 8].copy()
br_shift = br_active[:, 9]           # degrees
br_angmin = br_active[:, 11]
br_angmax = br_active[:, 12]

# Normalise tap
br_tap[br_tap == 0] = 1.0

# Compute branch admittance parameters
y_series = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
yc_from = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
yc_to = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
tap_complex = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)

for l in range(n_branch):
    z = complex(br_r[l], br_x[l])
    if abs(z) > 0:
        y_series[l] = 1.0 / z
    else:
        # Pure reactance shouldn't happen, but guard
        y_series[l] = complex(0, -1.0 / br_x[l]) if br_x[l] != 0 else 0
    yc_from[l] = complex(0, br_b[l] / 2.0)
    yc_to[l] = complex(0, br_b[l] / 2.0)
    shift_rad = math.radians(br_shift[l])
    tap_complex[l] = br_tap[l] * complex(math.cos(shift_rad), math.sin(shift_rad))

# Pre-compute real/imag parts for the Pyomo model
# For S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  - conj(Y_ij) * Vi * Vj* / T_ij
# Let A_l = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ij) / |T_ij|^2
# Let B_l = conj(Y_ij) / T_ij
# Then S_ij = A_l * |Vi|^2 - B_l * Vi * Vj*
#
# For S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ji) * |Vj|^2 - conj(Y_ij) * Vi* * Vj / T_ij*
# Let C_l = conj(Y_ij + Yc_ji)
# Let D_l = conj(Y_ij) / conj(T_ij)  = conj(Y_ij / T_ij) ... but actually conj(Y_ij) / conj(T_ij)
# Then S_ji = C_l * |Vj|^2 - D_l * Vi* * Vj

A_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
B_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
C_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)
D_coeff = np.zeros(n_branch, dtype=complex)

for l in range(n_branch):
    t = tap_complex[l]
    t_mag2 = abs(t) ** 2
    ys = y_series[l]
    ycf = yc_from[l]
    yct = yc_to[l]

    A_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys + ycf) / t_mag2
    B_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys) / t
    C_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys + yct)
    D_coeff[l] = np.conj(ys) / np.conj(t)

# Extract real/imag
A_re = A_coeff.real;  A_im = A_coeff.imag
B_re = B_coeff.real;  B_im = B_coeff.imag
C_re = C_coeff.real;  C_im = C_coeff.imag
D_re = D_coeff.real;  D_im = D_coeff.imag

# Branches at each bus (for nodal balance)
branches_from_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}   # (l, 'from')
branches_to_bus = {bid: [] for bid in bus_ids}     # (l, 'to')
for l in range(n_branch):
    branches_from_bus[br_f[l]].append(l)
    branches_to_bus[br_t[l]].append(l)

print(f"Network: {n_bus} buses, {n_gen} generators, {n_branch} branches")
print(f"Total load: {bus_raw[:,2].sum():.2f} MW, {bus_raw[:,3].sum():.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Reference bus: {ref_buses}")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Build Pyomo model
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
m = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# Sets
m.BUS = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
m.GEN = pyo.RangeSet(0, n_gen - 1)
m.BRANCH = pyo.RangeSet(0, n_branch - 1)

# Variables – rectangular voltage
m.e = pyo.Var(m.BUS, initialize=1.0)   # real part
m.f = pyo.Var(m.BUS, initialize=0.0)   # imaginary part

# Set voltage magnitude bounds via e, f bounds
# |V| in [vmin, vmax] => e^2+f^2 in [vmin^2, vmax^2]
# We set e in [-vmax, vmax], f in [-vmax, vmax] (loose box)
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    m.e[bid].setlb(-float(vmax[i]))
    m.e[bid].setub(float(vmax[i]))
    m.f[bid].setlb(-float(vmax[i]))
    m.f[bid].setub(float(vmax[i]))

# Generator power
m.pg = pyo.Var(m.GEN, initialize=0.5)
m.qg = pyo.Var(m.GEN, initialize=0.0)

for g in range(n_gen):
    m.pg[g].setlb(float(pmin[g]))
    m.pg[g].setub(float(pmax[g]))
    m.qg[g].setlb(float(qmin[g]))
    m.qg[g].setub(float(qmax[g]))
    # Init at midpoint
    m.pg[g].value = float((pmin[g] + pmax[g]) / 2.0)
    m.qg[g].value = float((qmin[g] + qmax[g]) / 2.0)

# Objective: minimize generation cost (in $/hr, using MW values)
# cost_k = c2_k * (pg_k * baseMVA)^2 + c1_k * (pg_k * baseMVA) + c0_k
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(
        float(cost_c2[g]) * (m.pg[g] * baseMVA) ** 2
        + float(cost_c1[g]) * (m.pg[g] * baseMVA)
        + float(cost_c0[g])
        for g in range(n_gen)
    )

m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

# Constraint: reference bus angle = 0  => f[ref] = 0
def ref_angle_rule(m, r):
    return m.f[r] == 0.0

m.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# Constraint: voltage magnitude bounds
# vmin^2 <= e^2 + f^2 <= vmax^2
def vm_lb_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    return m.e[bid] ** 2 + m.f[bid] ** 2 >= float(vmin[i]) ** 2

def vm_ub_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    return m.e[bid] ** 2 + m.f[bid] ** 2 <= float(vmax[i]) ** 2

m.vm_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=vm_lb_rule)
m.vm_ub = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=vm_ub_rule)

# Branch power flow expressions
# S_ij (from side):
#   P_ij = A_re * (ei^2+fi^2) - B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#   Q_ij = A_im * (ei^2+fi^2) + B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#     (note: for conj(...) * Vi * Vj*, we expand carefully)
#
# Actually: S_ij = A * |Vi|^2 - B * (Vi * Vj*)
#   where Vi*Vj* = (ei+jfi)(ej-jfj) = (ei*ej+fi*fj) + j(fi*ej - ei*fj)
# So P_ij = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)]
#         = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#    Q_ij = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)]
#         = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#
# Wait, let me redo this more carefully.
# S_ij = A * |Vi|^2 - B * Vi * conj(Vj)
# Let's denote Vi*conj(Vj) = W_ij
# W_ij = (ei + j*fi)*(ej - j*fj) = (ei*ej + fi*fj) + j*(fi*ej - ei*fj)
# So:
#   P_ij = Re(S_ij) = Re(A)*|Vi|^2 - Re(B * W_ij)
#        = A_re*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - B_im*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#   Q_ij = Im(S_ij) = Im(A)*|Vi|^2 - Im(B * W_ij)
#        = A_im*(ei^2+fi^2) - [B_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + B_re*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#
# Similarly S_ji = C * |Vj|^2 - D * conj(Vi) * Vj
# conj(Vi)*Vj = (ei - j*fi)*(ej + j*fj) = (ei*ej+fi*fj) - j*(fi*ej - ei*fj) = conj(W_ij)
# So:
#   P_ji = C_re*(ej^2+fj^2) - [D_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + D_im*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#   Q_ji = C_im*(ej^2+fj^2) - [D_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - D_re*(fi*ej - ei*fj)]
#
# Wait: D * conj(W_ij) = (D_re + j*D_im) * ((ei*ej+fi*fj) - j*(fi*ej-ei*fj))
#   Re = D_re*(ei*ej+fi*fj) + D_im*(fi*ej-ei*fj)
#   Im = D_im*(ei*ej+fi*fj) - D_re*(fi*ej-ei*fj)

def pf_from(l, m):
    """Real power flow on from-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_i = ei**2 + fi**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(A_re[l]) * vm2_i - (float(B_re[l]) * re_wij - float(B_im[l]) * im_wij)

def qf_from(l, m):
    """Reactive power flow on from-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_i = ei**2 + fi**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(A_im[l]) * vm2_i - (float(B_im[l]) * re_wij + float(B_re[l]) * im_wij)

def pf_to(l, m):
    """Real power flow on to-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_j = ej**2 + fj**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(C_re[l]) * vm2_j - (float(D_re[l]) * re_wij + float(D_im[l]) * im_wij)

def qf_to(l, m):
    """Reactive power flow on to-side of branch l."""
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    vm2_j = ej**2 + fj**2
    re_wij = ei*ej + fi*fj
    im_wij = fi*ej - ei*fj
    return float(C_im[l]) * vm2_j - (float(D_im[l]) * re_wij - float(D_re[l]) * im_wij)

# Nodal power balance constraints
# sum(Pg) - Pd - Gs*|V|^2 = sum(Pf_from) + sum(Pf_to)   [real]
# sum(Qg) - Qd + Bs*|V|^2 = sum(Qf_from) + sum(Qf_to)   [reactive]
# Note: shunt admittance Y^s = gs + j*bs
#   conj(Y^s)*|V|^2 = (gs - j*bs)*|V|^2
#   Real part consumed: gs*|V|^2
#   Reactive part consumed: -bs*|V|^2  (i.e., bs > 0 injects reactive)

def p_balance_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    # Generation
    pg_sum = sum(m.pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    # Load
    load_p = float(pd[i])
    # Shunt: consumes gs*|V|^2
    shunt_p = float(gs[i]) * (m.e[bid]**2 + m.f[bid]**2)
    # Branch flows
    flow_p = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        flow_p += pf_from(l, m)
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        flow_p += pf_to(l, m)
    return pg_sum - load_p - shunt_p == flow_p

def q_balance_rule(m, bid):
    i = bus_id2idx[bid]
    # Generation
    qg_sum = sum(m.qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    # Load
    load_q = float(qd[i])
    # Shunt: consumes -bs*|V|^2 reactive (bs > 0 => injects vars)
    shunt_q = -float(bs[i]) * (m.e[bid]**2 + m.f[bid]**2)
    # Branch flows
    flow_q = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        flow_q += qf_from(l, m)
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        flow_q += qf_to(l, m)
    return qg_sum - load_q - shunt_q == flow_q

m.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=p_balance_rule)
m.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.BUS, rule=q_balance_rule)

# Branch flow limits: |S_ij|^2 <= (rate_a)^2   (from and to sides)
# Only for branches with finite limits
def sf_from_limit_rule(m, l):
    if rate_a[l] <= 0 or rate_a[l] > 99.0:  # 9900 MVA / 100 = 99 pu, effectively unlimited
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    p = pf_from(l, m)
    q = qf_from(l, m)
    return p**2 + q**2 <= float(rate_a[l])**2

def sf_to_limit_rule(m, l):
    if rate_a[l] <= 0 or rate_a[l] > 99.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    p = pf_to(l, m)
    q = qf_to(l, m)
    return p**2 + q**2 <= float(rate_a[l])**2

m.sf_from_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=sf_from_limit_rule)
m.sf_to_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=sf_to_limit_rule)

# Angle difference constraints
# theta_ij_min <= angle(Vi * conj(Vj)) <= theta_ij_max
# angle(Vi*conj(Vj)) = atan2(fi*ej - ei*fj, ei*ej + fi*fj)
# We linearize using: tan(min) * (ei*ej+fi*fj) <= (fi*ej-ei*fj) <= tan(max) * (ei*ej+fi*fj)
# This is valid when |theta| < 90 degrees, which is typical
def angle_diff_lb_rule(m, l):
    angmin = float(br_angmin[l])
    if angmin <= -90.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi_v = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    re_w = ei*ej + fi_v*fj
    im_w = fi_v*ej - ei*fj
    return im_w >= math.tan(math.radians(angmin)) * re_w

def angle_diff_ub_rule(m, l):
    angmax = float(br_angmax[l])
    if angmax >= 90.0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    ei = m.e[fi_bus]; fi_v = m.f[fi_bus]
    ej = m.e[ti_bus]; fj = m.f[ti_bus]
    re_w = ei*ej + fi_v*fj
    im_w = fi_v*ej - ei*fj
    return im_w <= math.tan(math.radians(angmax)) * re_w

m.angle_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angle_diff_lb_rule)
m.angle_ub = pyo.Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angle_diff_ub_rule)

print("Model built. Solving...")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Solve
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
solver = pyo.SolverFactory("ipopt", executable="/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 50000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-4
solver.options["print_level"] = 5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-1

results = solver.solve(m, tee=True)

tc = results.solver.termination_condition
print(f"\nSolver termination: {tc}")

if tc not in (
    pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal,
    pyo.TerminationCondition.locallyOptimal,
    pyo.TerminationCondition.feasible,
):
    solver_status = str(tc)
    print(f"WARNING: Solver did not find optimal solution: {tc}")
else:
    solver_status = "optimal"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Extract results and build report
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
obj_val = pyo.value(m.obj)

# Generator results
gen_results = []
total_pg_mw = 0.0
total_qg_mvar = 0.0
for g in range(n_gen):
    pg_mw = pyo.value(m.pg[g]) * baseMVA
    qg_mvar = pyo.value(m.qg[g]) * baseMVA
    total_pg_mw += pg_mw
    total_qg_mvar += qg_mvar
    gen_results.append({
        "id": g + 1,
        "bus": gen_bus[g],
        "pg_MW": round(pg_mw, 2),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg_mvar, 2),
        "pmin_MW": round(float(pmin[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "pmax_MW": round(float(pmax[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(float(qmin[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(float(qmax[g]) * baseMVA, 2),
    })

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm = math.sqrt(e_val**2 + f_val**2)
    va = math.degrees(math.atan2(f_val, e_val))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": bid,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 4),
        "va_deg": round(va, 4),
        "vmin_pu": float(vmin[i]),
        "vmax_pu": float(vmax[i]),
    })

# Branch loading
branch_loadings = []
for l in range(n_branch):
    fi_bus = br_f[l]
    ti_bus = br_t[l]
    # Compute flows
    pf_f = pyo.value(pf_from(l, m)) * baseMVA
    qf_f = pyo.value(qf_from(l, m)) * baseMVA
    pf_t = pyo.value(pf_to(l, m)) * baseMVA
    qf_t = pyo.value(qf_to(l, m)) * baseMVA
    mva_from = math.sqrt(pf_f**2 + qf_f**2)
    mva_to = math.sqrt(pf_t**2 + qf_t**2)
    limit_mva = float(rate_a[l]) * baseMVA
    if limit_mva > 0:
        loading = max(mva_from, mva_to) / limit_mva * 100.0
    else:
        loading = 0.0
    branch_loadings.append({
        "from_bus": fi_bus,
        "to_bus": ti_bus,
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 1),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(mva_from, 1),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(mva_to, 1),
        "limit_MVA": round(limit_mva, 1),
    })

# Sort by loading and take top 10
branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
top_branches = branch_loadings[:10]

# Feasibility check
total_load_mw = float(bus_raw[:, 2].sum())
total_load_mvar = float(bus_raw[:, 3].sum())
total_losses_mw = total_pg_mw - total_load_mw

# Compute power mismatches at each bus
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    # LHS of balance
    pg_sum = sum(pyo.value(m.pg[g]) for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm2 = e_val**2 + f_val**2

    lhs_p = pg_sum - float(pd[i]) - float(gs[i]) * vm2
    lhs_q = (sum(pyo.value(m.qg[g]) for g in gens_at_bus[bid]) if gens_at_bus[bid] else 0.0) \
             - float(qd[i]) + float(bs[i]) * vm2

    # RHS: branch flows
    rhs_p = 0.0
    rhs_q = 0.0
    for l in branches_from_bus[bid]:
        rhs_p += pyo.value(pf_from(l, m))
        rhs_q += pyo.value(qf_from(l, m))
    for l in branches_to_bus[bid]:
        rhs_p += pyo.value(pf_to(l, m))
        rhs_q += pyo.value(qf_to(l, m))

    p_mis = abs(lhs_p - rhs_p) * baseMVA
    q_mis = abs(lhs_q - rhs_q) * baseMVA
    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mis)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mis)

# Voltage violations
max_v_violation = 0.0
for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
    e_val = pyo.value(m.e[bid])
    f_val = pyo.value(m.f[bid])
    vm = math.sqrt(e_val**2 + f_val**2)
    v_viol = max(0, float(vmin[i]) - vm, vm - float(vmax[i]))
    max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, v_viol)

# Branch overloads
max_overload = 0.0
for bl in branch_loadings:
    if bl["limit_MVA"] > 0:
        overload = max(bl["flow_from_MVA"], bl["flow_to_MVA"]) - bl["limit_MVA"]
        if overload > 0:
            max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

# Build report
report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(obj_val, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_load_mw, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_load_mvar, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg_mw, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg_mvar, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses_mw, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": top_branches,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 2),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"ACOPF Solution Summary")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total Cost:       ${obj_val:,.2f}/hr")
print(f"Total Gen (P):    {total_pg_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Total Gen (Q):    {total_qg_mvar:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Load (P):   {total_load_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Total Load (Q):   {total_load_mvar:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Losses:     {total_losses_mw:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Max P mismatch:   {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max Q mismatch:   {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max V violation:  {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
print(f"Max branch overload: {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
print(f"Solver status:    {solver_status}")
print(f"\nReport written to /root/report.json")
